crossRefs.note: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”
translations.bsb: And David inquired of the young man who had brought him the report, “Where are you from?” “I am the son of a foreigner,” he answered. “I am an Amalekite.”
translations.kjv: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
translations.asv: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a sojourner, an Amalekite.
